description: Sprint 1004-lpn: 130 ruled lpn_ keys (calibration, criticality, contour, alternatives, copy lock, flow balance, fire-flow design check, hotkeys) into 26 languages, plus a 14-key resync; 46 keys awaiting Tom's ruling held back.

entries.complaint: 'Lock' in 'keep same lock' / 'make new lock' is an undefined metaphor for a file identity token.
entries.resolution: The lock is the edit lock of lpn_lock_* (it stops two people editing one file), not an identity token. Post-QA aligned every language's copy-lock wording with its own lpn_lock_* word and wrote the term to glossary.json.
